'''2023 U.S. National Championship''' was the Players Committee U.S. National Championship in Minneapolis, Minnesota, 1–2 April 2023. [[Hayes Hunter]] finished 1st in the Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-04-us-nationals-minneapolis-minnesota-april-1-2/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Dates:''' 1–2 April 2023
* '''GEMP importable decks:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=82668 forum]
